Why this way? The AI is asked to answer in JSON format: a sentence to speak, plus a list of actions such as {"m":[150,150,800]} for forward. The brain code runs those actions one by one, and the body still refuses dangerous movements. Follow and guard modes use only the ultrasonic sensors, so the robot cannot tell people from objects; it follows or guards anything that is in front of it.

The AI answers but the robot does not move: look at the Serial Monitor. If you see "E DITOLAK", there is an obstacle or the STOP button is latched.
Photo fails: is the camera on? Is the IP in KAMERA_ALAMAT correct? Is the /stream tab in the browser closed?
SPEAK gives "Tidak terdengar jelas": speak closer to the microphone, or GROQ_API_KEY has not been filled in.
The robot only obeys your chat ID. Anyone else who finds your bot gets the reply "aku hanya menurut ke pemilikku".
